| $f$ | $Y=0$ | $Y=1$ | $Y=2$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $X=0$ | $0.2$ | $0$ | $0$ |
| $X=1$ | $0$ | $0.1$ | $0.15$ |
| $X=2$ | $0$ | $0.25$ | $0.05$ |
| $X=3$ | $0.1$ | $0$ | $0.15$ |

Compute $P(0\le Y\le 1\,|\,X=3)$ given that the discrete random variables $X$ and $Y$ have the joint probability mass function $f(x,y)$ shown in the table above.
question.worked_solution:
By the multiplication law for conditional probability, the required conditional probability is given by

$$
\begin{aligned}P(0\le Y\le 1\,|\,X=3) & =\frac{P((0\le Y\le 1),X=3)}{P(X=3)} \\  & =\frac{P(X=3,(0\le Y\le 1))}{P(X=3)} \\  & =\frac{P(X=3,Y=0)+P(X=3,Y=1)}{P(X=3)} \\  & =\frac{f(3,0)+f(3,1)}{{f}_{X}(3)},\end{aligned}
$$

where $f(x,y)$ is the joint probability mass function of $X$ and $Y,$ and ${f}_{X}(x)$ is the marginal distribution of $X.$

Recall that the marginal distribution for $X$ corresponds to the row totals. Thus,

$$
\begin{aligned}{f}_{X}(3) & =f(3,0)+f(3,1)+f(3,2) \\  & =0.1+0+0.15 \\  & =0.25.\end{aligned}
$$

From the given table, we have that $f(3,0)=0.1$ and $f(3,1)=0.$ 

Finally, substituting our values into our formula above, we obtain 

$$
\begin{aligned}(0\le Y\le 1\,|\,X=3) & =\frac{f(3,0)+f(3,1)}{{f}_{X}(3)} \\  & =\frac{0.1+0}{0.25} \\  & =\frac{0.1}{0.25} \\  & =0.4.\end{aligned}
$$
